name: Kitt Kanto, Mayhem Diva — "Goad that creature" happens when fired, to the target only
notes: Memory: project_audit_small_clusters_round_eight_2026-10-11. The trait parser read "Goad that creature" inside Kitt's own triggered ability as a static effect on every creature, and in the fired ability gave it a second target slot. A pronoun object inside a permanent's own ability is no longer static, and in a fired ability it follows the one target. "Target creature that player controls" offers any creature. Whether the optional part was done is now asked with a toggle (project_asked_condition_toggles_2026-10-11); it is switched to Yes here.
